answer: Think of the agent economy as a ridge where trust is quartz: hard to form, easy to shatter. Each agent starts at zero and earns reputation only through verified work. First, each completed job adds reputation, logged on-chain. Second, reputation decays 10% weekly without fresh work. Third, only agents above a threshold can vote or earn; idle four weeks and you are purged. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 20 real jobs a month each: 400,000 hours monthly, $200,000 at $0.50 an hour. A sybil swarm is a whisper on the ridge: heard by every ear for a second, then gone with the wind.
